content.text:
I have everything I need. Writing `src/App.vue` now.

Design choices I'm making:
- Track cards use `href`, so the whole card is one link. There's no router in the project, so the track pages are plain links.
- Submit validates on click and never disables the button. Errors appear next to each field and in a summary that receives focus.
- Submitting opens a confirmation dialog. The booking happens only when they confirm.
- The reminder switch saves to `localStorage` on each change and announces it in a live region.

The landing page is built in `src/App.vue` and `npm run build` passes. I haven't opened it in a browser or run an accessibility audit, so the WCAG 2.2 AA and keyboard behaviour rest on the Cabinet components' documented contracts plus my reading of the code.

What's on the page:

- **Title and intro:** an `h1` and a short paragraph.
- **Tracks:** three `CabCard`s with `href` set to `/tracks/board`, `/tracks/digital` and `/tracks/larp`. The whole card is one link. There's no router in the project, so these are plain page links.
- **Sign-up:** name, email and experience level (a `CabSelect`), plus a code-of-conduct checkbox. Submitting validates everything. Errors appear next to each field and in a summary that takes focus. Nothing is submitted until the checkbox is accepted.
- **Confirmation:** a valid submit opens a `CabDialog` showing the details. The booking is only recorded when they press "Confirm booking". "Go back" returns to the form.
- **Email reminders:** a `CabSwitch` that saves to `localStorage` on each change and announces "on/off. Saved." in a live region. There's no save button.

Decisions you may want to change:

- **Booking is client-side only.** Confirming shows "Seat booked for …" and clears the form. Nothing is sent anywhere. You'll need to wire it to your backend.
- **Reminder setting is stored in the browser**, not on a server, so it won't follow the attendee to another device.
- **Code of conduct has no link.** `CabCheckbox` takes only a text label, so I didn't add a link to a page that doesn't exist yet.
- **Checkbox error is shown as hint text.** `CabCheckbox` has no error prop, so the message appears as plain hint text, not red error styling.

Things to check in a browser: that the confirmation dialog moves focus to "Go back" when it opens, and that the reminder announcement is read out with a screen reader.
